_note: Phase 2 features that can be switched on and off in the prototype. 'default' is what everyone sees until they change it on the Prototype settings page or with ?features= in a link. Add an entry when a feature is built; remove it once the feature is in the real service and the prototype has been re-synced. A feature can list others in 'requires': it is on only when they are on too, and switching it on switches them on.

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: A read-only view for the Marketplace Team of every registered user, application and production credentials request, on the Admin page that admins already see.

features.name: Production requests for each API
features.description: A production credentials request covers the APIs you choose, and each API gets its own outcome, because the Data Access Team review each API in an application. You can ask for more of an application's APIs later, with your earlier answers filled in. On the application page, the Production section lists the APIs in a table with each one's status and what you can do next, and its production subscription key folded under it once made.

features.name: Get production credentials yourself
features.description: Once the Data Access Team approve a production request, the Marketplace Team record the decision on the Admin pages. The requester is emailed, signs in and generates their own production credentials, with the client secret shown once.

features.name: Application page in tabs
features.description: The application page splits into a Try it now tab and a Production tab, with the application's details above them and Delete below. Links about production access open the Production tab. If both application page layouts are on, the page uses tabs.

features.name: Application page in summary cards
features.description: The application page groups Try it now and Production into a summary card each, so everything stays on one page but each environment is in its own box.

features.name: Regenerate client secrets
features.description: A Regenerate link beside the client secret on the application page makes a new secret, which is shown once; the old one stops working straight away. For Try it now, and for production too when 'Get production credentials yourself' is on. The real service had this for Try it now until October 2026, when it was taken out because the backend has no way to replace a secret.
